messages:
mira: Quick alert — landed NovaLedger LoRA merge on staging and ran the tiny smoke suite. Seeing a repeatable money/decimal shift on int4 only. int8/fp16 look fine.

mira: Example from smoke: 
```
prompt: "Total due: $2,345.67"
fp16: "Total due: $2,345.67"
int4 merged: "Total due: $234.567"  // decimal moved
```

amir: sounds like LoRA delta magnitudes + int4 quant rounding. Did base + int4 reproduce?

mira: base-int4 was 92% numeric_exact_match; merged-int4 dropped to 60% on 50-sample smoke. So merge introduces the failure.

priya: can you paste tokenization for a fail and run merge-with-clip or scale alpha down?

mira: tokenization looks fine (commas and decimals preserved). Kicked off re-merges: alpha=0.6 job 4001 and merge-with-clip alpha=0.6 job 4002.

(eval-bot): Job 4001 finished: int4 numeric_exact_match=85%.

(eval-bot): Job 4002 finished: int4 numeric_exact_match=91%. Remaining fails 5/50, consistent.

tomas: great. propose canary: promote merge-with-clip alpha=0.6 to staging-canary and enable a customer-scoped post-process that normalizes currency spans while we dig deeper. @mira please prepare canary manifest. @priya own monitoring.

mira: filing ticket RW-12178 and uploading eval artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/novaledger/4002/. Will implement feature-flagged numeric post-process.

jen: customer update queued; will offer canary and rollback plan.

amir: follow-ups: audit quant params used by merge codepath, add unit tests for numeric token preservation, and consider a small retrain of the LoRA with per-channel clipping.

mira: noted — adding checklist to RW-12178. will post canary link when deployed.
